name: 46-trpc-dataloader-result-loop
title: Flatten batch result handling in dataLoader
body: Simplifies the dispatch result handler in the client dataLoader by iterating the results with forEach instead of mapping them into a Promise.all, which also lets the then-callback be synchronous. The per-item resolve/reject and cleanup logic is unchanged.

bugs.why: The async per-item callbacks are no longer awaited, so the following 'Missing result' loop runs before any `await Promise.resolve(...)` settles and rejects every item in the batch before its real value is delivered.
